slides.title: TriLog See Your Life at a Glance Track
slides.text: TriLog See Your Life at a Glance Track mood, energy, and activities in a beautiful visual timeline. Spot patterns. Build habits. Know yourself better. Mood Energy Available on iOS  •  Free with optional Pro

slides.title: What is TriLog? A visual life tracker that
slides.text: What is TriLog? A visual life tracker that turns your daily mood, energy, and activities into patterns you can see and learn from. Mood 5 emotional states from Happy to Upset. Quick tap, don't overthink it. Energy 5 vitality levels from exhausted to fully charged. Separate from mood. Activity What you're doing: Sleep, Work, Exercise, Leisure, Socialize, and more. Quick entry in seconds

slides.title: The Visual Grid Your entire week on one
slides.text: The Visual Grid Your entire week on one screen — 7 days × 24 hours = 168 hours at a glance Columns = Days Sunday through Saturday, current day highlighted Rows = Hours Midnight to midnight, 24-hour vertical axis Colored Blocks Activities shown as colored bars: blue=sleep, red=work, green=exercise, purple=leisure Mood & Energy Dots Small colored indicators at activity boundaries Weather Strip Daily weather icons with temperature at bottom Moon Phases Lunar cycle indicators for sleep pattern correlation Light theme

slides.title: Focus on What Matters Switch between all metrics
slides.text: Focus on What Matters Switch between all metrics or isolate mood, energy, or activity across 3 weeks All Metrics Activity Only Energy Only Mood Only

slides.title: Effortless Tracking Quick Track Log mood, energy, and
slides.text: Effortless Tracking Quick Track Log mood, energy, and activity in seconds. Tap icons — no modals, no friction. See recent events in a timeline. Perfect for busy days. Polling Notifications Gentle reminders every 15–90 minutes ask how you're doing. Respond in one tap via Quick Track. More data points, richer patterns. Quick Track Polling

slides.title: Add Context with Notes Notes tell you why
slides.text: Add Context with Notes Notes tell you why — not just how you felt, but what caused it General Quick context: "bad sleep", "great workout" Meal Notes Prefix with 'm': m lunch 450 — tracks calories Health Notes Prefix with 'h': h headache, h took ibuprofen Cycle Notes Prefix with 'cy': cy started, cy day 14 Also includes: shorthand expansions, search, and filterable note types Grid with notes Note filters

slides.title: Metrics & Charts Multiple views reveal different patterns
slides.text: Metrics & Charts Multiple views reveal different patterns in your data 7-Day Metrics Grid Activity Bar Chart Metrics Grid Daily rows for mood, energy, sleep, steps, calories, and custom trackers. Charts View Bar and pie charts show activity distribution over 7 or 21 days. Extended Views 14-day scrollable metrics and year-long habit views for deep pattern analysis.

slides.title: Build Better Habits Daily recurring tasks tracked with
slides.text: Build Better Habits Daily recurring tasks tracked with visual consistency grids 21-Day Habit Grid Year View How It Works Create daily habits like meditation, vitamins, reading Check off completions in Day End or the Habits grid See 21-day consistency at a glance — solid rows = strong habits Year-long calendar view shows long-term patterns Weekday vs. weekend differences become obvious Start with 1–3 habits, add more as they stick

slides.title: Day Launch & Day End Optional structured routines
slides.text: Day Launch & Day End Optional structured routines for morning reflection and evening planning ☀️  Day Launch Sleep Quality & Onset (0–5) Waking feeling & wake-ups Sleep duration & insomnia Yesterday's goals review Morning routine checklist (Pro) 🌙  Day End Tomorrow's top 3 targets Journal space for reflection Habit completion checkboxes Wellness check ratings Resting heart rate (Pro, iOS)

slides.title: Pro Features The free version is complete. Pro
slides.text: Pro Features The free version is complete. Pro adds power features for dedicated trackers. Pomodoro Timer Pomodoro Timer 25-min focus sessions with short/long breaks. Tracks sessions and integrates with your timeline. Custom Trackers Track anything: water intake, medication, pain levels, coffee. Types: text, count, sum, traffic light. Quick Track Rapid one-tap logging without opening the full entry modal. Perfect with Polling. Morning Routine Customizable checklist in Day Launch. Markdown-based, resets daily. Entry History

slides.title: Your App, Your Way Extensive settings let you
slides.text: Your App, Your Way Extensive settings let you show exactly what matters to you Appearance Settings Light Theme Settings Display Toggles Calories, Steps, Moon Phases, Weather, Cycles, Mood Icons, View Dots Theme Light, Dark, or follow System preference Backup & Restore iCloud auto-sync, database export, Google Sheets export View Management Show/hide Trackers and Habits grids, customize Metrics rows Privacy First All data stored locally on device. Your data is yours alone.

slides.title: The Longer You Track, The More You See
slides.text: The Longer You Track, The More You See First Week Learning the app. Finding your logging rhythm. First Month Patterns emerge: energy dips, mood correlations, sleep effects. Several Months Weekly rhythms, monthly cycles, life change impacts visible. A Year+ Seasonal patterns. A profound record of your life. The goal isn't to optimize your life. It's to notice it. Tracking without reviewing is like writing a journal you never read. TriLog makes the review effortless. Download TriLog Free on the App Store  •  Pro subscription for power features
